sites.downstream: simple_classify() returns one of 10 enumerated insurance category labels; consumed as a plain string by callers
sites.reason: Closed-set classification selecting one of 10 fixed insurance categories over trusted customer support ticket text. No math, dates, multi-hop reasoning, generation, or adversarial input. Maps directly to Choice primitive.

options.benefit: Jev Choice is purpose-built for closed-set classification; accepted decisions are faster and cheaper than Claude Haiku. Expected cost = Jev cost + fallback_fraction x Anthropic cost.
options.risk: Serial miss adds Jev latency before original inference. Conservative fallback always retained.
